verificationBody.rejected: Upload the papers again after fixing this:
verificationBody.suspended: No new bookings. Contact EventSeva support:

engine.docsAfterSave: After saving, upload the RC and insurance (car) or the licence (driver) for EventSeva to check.
engine.papersHint: Private: only the EventSeva team sees them.
engine.addonsHint: Things customers can add to a booking, like decoration or an extra hour.
engine.addonNamePlaceholder: e.g. Flower decoration on the car
engine.addonPriceHint: Added to the booking price. ₹0 for something free.
engine.addonApprovalNoNote: It is added to the booking straight away.
engine.addonApprovalYesNote: You say yes or no when you accept the request.
engine.deleteAddonBody: Customers can no longer pick it. Bookings already made keep it.
engine.bundlesHint: Services booked together, with an optional discount.
engine.bundleOneMandatory: Mark at least one service “Always included”
engine.bundleDiscountHint: Up to 50%, on the services booked in the package.
engine.deleteBundleBody: Customers can no longer book it as a package.

carTrip.title: Trip
carTrip.noDrivers: No verified driver yet. Add a driver and their licence in Services & bookings.
carTrip.handoverHint: When the car leaves: note the odometer and fuel, and take photos of all four sides.
carTrip.returnHint: When the car is back: note the odometer and fuel, and any extra charges.
carTrip.extraChargesHint: Extra km and late return are worked out from the agreed rates. Add fuel, tolls, parking and damage here; the customer can accept or dispute them.
carTrip.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Small dent on the bumper already there
carTrip.chargeError: Check the amounts: each damage needs a description and at least ₹1.

readingError.odometer: Enter the odometer reading in km.
readingError.below: The odometer cannot be below {{km}} km (at handover).

carTrip.returnConfirmBody: The customer sees the readings and charges. The deposit is settled once they accept or 48 hours pass.

done.driver: Driver assigned. The customer is told.

changes.title: Change requests
changes.approved: Change approved. The customer is told.
changes.declineBody: The booking stays as it is. The customer sees your reason.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.notFinal: Not final yet: the invoice is issued when the booking is completed.

handoverCode.label: Customer’s handover code
handoverCode.hint: Ask the customer for the 6-digit code in their app. With it, this record counts as agreed by them.

cash.allowHint: Customers may choose to pay you the whole booking in cash. EventSeva’s commission on it is taken from your next online payouts.
cash.title: Cash payment
cash.vendorNote: The customer pays you {{amount}} in person. EventSeva’s commission of {{commission}} is taken from your next online payout.
cash.requestBody: If you accept, the booking is confirmed straight away. Collect the money in person and record it here.
cash.cancelBody: The customer is told how much cash to expect back by the cancellation rules.
cash.duesBody: It is taken from your next online payouts. Above {{limit}}, customers cannot choose cash for your bookings.
cash.duesOver: Customers cannot choose cash for your bookings until this is below {{limit}}. It comes off your next online payout, or pay EventSeva and support will mark it.
